technique_name: Compare and contrast the individualistic and collectivist cultures.
description: Individualistic cultures emphasize the importance of individual autonomy, self-sufficiency, and personal achievement. These cultures prioritize individual accomplishment and reward those who are successful in their endeavors. In contrast, collectivist cultures emphasize communal values and collective responsibility.
